definition: Topic distinguishes use of a sentence, its semantic truth conditions, the purposes of moral talk and the supervenience competence requirement. Explains is a primitive directed relation among these topics. Anti and Realist instantiate the existing source readings at opposite use/truth-condition edges; Asymmetric instantiates the existing explicit open exclusion premise. SharedDataDoNotChooseOrder constructs both relations on exactly one shared Data value, each satisfying that exclusion and the competence-explanation edge. No unencoded metaphysical law or complete rival worldview is claimed.
note: A typed test interface for #191. Sources motivate the relata but do not provide laws connecting explanation to truthmaking. Those substantive bridges require further source research.
